component.name: Pipnode
component.summary: Build dataflows visually by wiring nodes together

description.p: Pipnode is a desktop visual flow editor for Linux, inspired by Node-RED. Drag nodes onto a worksheet, wire them together, and build dataflows — network probes, MQTT, sensors, gauges, image processing, LLM calls, and more — without writing glue code. It is a native GTK 3 application written in C, with a first-class plugin system so the node catalogue can grow without forking the core.
This community-edition build bundles the open-source plugins:

ul.li: Network — HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket, MQTT, DNS and crypto-rate nodes
Image — blur, sharpen, colour, geometry, edge detection and more
Tasmota — smart-plug power, energy and sensor readings
Host monitoring — CPU, memory, load, disk, network and temperature
Shell — run commands, df, free and tmux session monitoring
Sound effects and Ollama (local LLM) nodes

description.p: Note: as a sandboxed Flatpak, the Shell and Host-monitoring nodes operate inside the application sandbox rather than against the host system. For full host access, use a native build from source.
